Leveraging Investments and Finance for a Green Transition (LIFT)

description.narrative: Leveraging Investments and Finance for a Green Transition (LIFT) is an initiative implemented by Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI), to support selected Sida partners in achieving their Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) targets. The program will unlock up to $50 million in climate finance from both public and private sources. It will also work with financial institutions and other actors in the financial ecosystem to strengthen their capacity for green lending. Through a tailored approach, GGGI will ensure that organizations receive support suited to their specific needs, level of readiness, and institutional capacity, thereby maximizing effectiveness and long-term impact.

Leveraging Investments and Finance for a Green Transition (LIFT) är ett initiativ som genomförs av Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) för att stödja av Sida utvalda partners i arbete med att uppnå sina nationellt fastställda klimatmål (NDC). Programmet kommer att mobilisera upp till 50 miljoner USD i klimatfinansiering från både offentlig och privat kapital. Programmet kommer också att stödja finansinstitutioner och andra aktörer i det finansiella ekosystemet för att stärka deras kapacitet för grön utlåning. Genom ett skräddarsytt arbetssätt kommer GGGI att säkerställa att organisationerna får stöd som är anpassat till deras specifika behov, beredskapsnivå och institutionella kapacitet, vilket därigenom maximerar effektivitet och långsiktig påverkan.

The Swedish contribution to Leveraging Investments and Finance for a Green Transition (LIFT), set for a 29-months implementation period will support selected Sida partners in partner countries in achieving their NDC targets by increasing access up to $50M in climate finance from public and/or private sources. Additionally, financial institutions and partners in the financial ecosystem will be supported to increase their green lending capacity. GGGI will develop a tailored approach to ensure that organizations receive the appropriate level of support based on their specific needs, readiness and institutional capacities. LIFT will increase access to climate finance by focusing on three overarching outcomes:
Outcome 1: Increase access to climate finance for selected partner countries - GGGI will support Sida partners to develop high quality concept notes and proposals for accessing climate finance from multilateral funds including GCF, GEF and AF, multilateral development bank including AfDB, World Bank and other sources.
Outcome 2: Strengthened the institutional capacity to access and manage climate finance, including accreditation to GCF and AF - GGGI will provide 2-3 Sida partners who have been nominated ny the national designated authorities to multilateral funds with accreditation process. In addition, GGGI will carry out technical assistance support geared towards increased capacity of entities in Climate Finance, tools, instruments.
Outcome 3: Operationalisation of the GTM to enlist other commercial banks/financial institutions (FIs) - through an in depth gap assessment, GTM will support FIs and partners in the financial ecosystem through a tailor made Technical Assistance (TA) addressing the gaps for an increased green loan portfolio.
